content: STEP 1 - read the round inputs. Read manifests/BRad-RQ_r10.txt (claims 14 source files incl. model/model.py 118 lines, model/layers.py 387, model/behaviour_radius.py 106, model/frechet_poincare.py 206, train_rqvae.py 640), findings/BRad-RQ_r10.json (previous review at revision 10: two blocking findings, both "model/model.py and model/__init__.py absent, set_radii/scale_by_radius/get_indices do not exist, radius never reaches the quantizer"), SCOPE_CONTRACT.md (one run, switches must exist, no ablation run). Then read train_rqvae.py in full (640 lines) and tests/test_ddp.py in full (107 lines) from the tree. OPEN: model/ files unreadable, see step 2.

STEP 2/3 - probe of the tree: glob "**/*" under the tree returns exactly two files (train_rqvae.py, tests/test_ddp.py); glob of the round dir returns every file unfiltered (so glob is not silently filtering); grep for "class RQVAE|def get_indices|def set_radii|def init_codebook" over the tree returns only train_rqvae.py:485 and test_ddp.py:75,94 (calls, no definitions); read of model/model.py is refused and grep on that exact path reports "Search path does not exist"; model/layers.py and tests/test_codebook_step.py are refused (out of scope / absent). Conclusion: no model/ package in the delivered tree, so nothing named by the manifest except the two files is present; the previous review's blocking defect (missing model/model.py, missing set_radii/scale_by_radius/get_indices) is still present. Trainer step-loop trace of train_rqvae.py: collectives are init_process_group :322; broadcast code_embs x3 :429; barrier :430; all_reduce tangent/weight per pending slot :490-491 inside "if sums:"; all_reduce loss/recon :503-504 per epoch; barrier :551 in eval branch; barrier/destroy :600-601. Answer written as final record.
